encode_mel_spectrograms_to_embeddings: use MimoAudioEncoder to encode mel spectrograms into LLM-compatible embeddings for multimodal audio processing
initialize_mimo_audio_encoder: create a MimoAudioEncoder with a config dict and model path to load the audio tokenizer
tokenize_audio_batch: use tokenize_audio_batch to encode multiple mel spectrograms into VQ codes in a single batch call
encode_audio_with_tokenizer: use MiMoAudioTokenizer.encode to convert mel spectrograms into hidden states and vector quantization codes
process_audio_codes: use MimoAudioEncoder.process_audio to pad and reshape audio codes to the required group size boundary
